svg.title: Donation lockup — ṚTAM Foundation with supporting line
svg.desc: Lockup for donation receipts, fundraising pages, and contribution forms. Sacred wordmark, thin gold rule, and a single quiet line of supporting copy — charcoal at light weight (stone failed the 4.5:1 body floor on ivory at this size; the weight keeps it quiet, the colour keeps it legible). No CTA chrome — the lockup is a header, not a button.
